tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. A white with a faint red bias, never pure white. Most sections sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: the light Button, MenuButton, PaddleTile backs.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Hover state of surface-raised fills; wells behind photo grids.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and meta lines on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Photo captions, years, small labels on surface. 4.5:1 or better on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers that only separate, never carry meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines that carry meaning: the EventCard frame, outline Button. 3:1 or better on surface.

tokens.name: perforation
tokens.usage: The ball-hole texture behind light sections. Deliberately low contrast: texture, not content.

tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: The brand red. Primary Button fill, tag bars, the FooterPanel frame, paddle faces. Text on it is on-crimson.

tokens.name: crimson-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of crimson fills; secondary colour block.

tokens.name: crimson-text
tokens.usage: Red used AS text: the serif accent words in a Headline, link hover. 4.5:1 or better on surface and night.

tokens.name: on-crimson
tokens.usage: Text and icons on crimson and crimson-deep (5.9:1 and 7.9:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Pure white for objects, not grounds: the ball, white paddle faces.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 3px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Ground of night sections (.ch-night) in both themes: the manifesto, marquee and FooterPanel.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: Quiet fills inside night sections.

tokens.name: night-ink
tokens.usage: Text on night and night-raised.

tokens.name: night-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on night.

tokens.name: night-ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions and small labels on night (5.9:1).

tokens.name: night-line
tokens.usage: Meaningful outlines inside night sections.

tokens.name: night-perforation
tokens.usage: Ball-hole texture on night.

tokens.name: night-crimson-text
tokens.usage: Serif accent words on night (4.8:1).

styles.name: impact
styles.usage: One per page: the manifesto or footer line. Uppercase, width 93%.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles. Uppercase. Larger than h1 by design.

styles.name: serif-impact
styles.usage: Accent words inside an impact Headline, in crimson-text.

styles.name: serif-quote
styles.sample: It doesn't matter how you serve, it's how you finish the rally.
styles.usage: Pull quotes, sentence case, wide tracking.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Find a doubles partner at your level in under a minute.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Games to 11, win by 2. Rally scoring.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Photo captions as PLACE, YEAR. Uppercase, ink-faint.

tokens.name: space-mini
tokens.usage: Inner padding of buttons and small cards.

tokens.name: space-container
tokens.usage: Page side gutter and the FooterPanel frame width.

tokens.name: space-gap
tokens.usage: Default gap between siblings.

tokens.name: space-small
tokens.usage: Gap between a block and its caption group; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-med
tokens.usage: Gap between components inside a section.

tokens.name: space-large
tokens.usage: Gap between sub-sections.

tokens.name: space-xlarge
tokens.usage: Gap between full sections.

tokens.name: space-nav
tokens.usage: Top offset under the fixed nav bar.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons and MenuButton.

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: PaddleTile, the FooterPanel tab.

tokens.name: radius-med
tokens.usage: The FooterPanel's night panel.

tokens.name: radius-large
tokens.usage: Pills and very large panels.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of every Button; MenuButton is this square.

tokens.name: size-tagbar-w
tokens.usage: Width of the crimson tag bar above captions.

tokens.name: size-tagbar-h
tokens.usage: Height of the tag bar.
